governor.responsibility: One modular monolith; Hono/Better Auth ingress, in-process modules and shared command/query path; serves static NewUI assets

config-compiler.responsibility: Compile reviewed Git declarations; validate UI manifest against image build; immutable release activation

governance.responsibility: Current identity and role matrix, TOTP step-up, exact approvals and short-lived opaque online effect permits

mastra-adapter.responsibility: Execute pinned Brain IR through trusted Governor primitives; no independent execution permission

scheduler.responsibility: Global admission, capabilities, job leases, resource fencing and reconciliation

memory-gateway.responsibility: Authorized knowledge scopes, provenance, publication and revocation

git.responsibility: Stable declarations and reviewed source releases

control-db.responsibility: Global identity, job, lease, approval/effect and audit authority

workspace-db.responsibility: Local business state, evidence indexes and idempotent global projections

mastra-db.responsibility: Private per-workspace engine snapshots; no authorization authority

artifacts.responsibility: Immutable content-addressed bytes and portable release/evidence references

tencentdb.responsibility: Scoped memory and knowledge assets; no operational permission

runner.responsibility: Outbound authenticated supervisor; isolated slots, current leases, engine-neutral session execution

tool-broker.responsibility: Pinned tools, target preconditions, narrow credentials and effect receipts

evaluator.responsibility: Independent attempts produce pinned evidence checks; Governor accepts verdicts

harness-adapter.responsibility: Normalize Pi/Claude/ACP session capabilities and events inside an isolated runner slot; no global authority

launcher.responsibility: Trusted constrained Unix HTTP launcher; preinstalled rootless Docker profiles, enforced egress proxy and owned cleanup; never exposed to agent slots

authorities.operations: control.db and workspace.db within explicit transaction boundaries
authorities.execution: Leased runners and governed tool broker
authorities.verification: Independent evaluators with Governor verdict acceptance
authorities.presentation: NewUI public packages plus Brain domain compositions; no authority elevation

boundaries.outputContract: Immutable web bundle and theme-aware product compositions
